context: Hiroshi-elder watches a sumo championship; explains to Sho-young.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、力士、皮、すごい!
lines.en: Grandpa — the wrestlers' skin is amazing!
lines.style: Wide-eyed wonder in the opening. Breathless, pointing-energy. Genuine amazement without performance. Soft lilt upward at the end — inviting him to share it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Warm, measured response. Soft Kansai cadence. Pride in the words without raising voice. Patient, like he's been waiting to share this with someone who'd really listen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 勝負、長年、続いとるのね。
lines.en: It keeps going, year after year.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Thoughtful rhythm — not rushing. Small boy noticing something real. Soft reverence for the continuity itself, not the spectacle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: We respect what we've been given.
lines.style: Gentle, philosophical. Kansai warmth underneath. Speaking from something lived. Slow pace. Weight in the words without heaviness. Eye-level with the boy's understanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 熱心に応援する、お父さん!
lines.en: Dad cheers so hard for them!
lines.style: Bright recognition — he's made a connection. Quick warmth in the voice. Small laugh-note underneath, delighted by his own observation. Eyes lighting up.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前も、いつか、好きになるで。
lines.style: Tender certainty. Soft, unhurried. Not a promise being made — a gentle expectation he's had all along. Warmth that holds the boy's future without need to explain it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright agreement. Quick, honest enthusiasm. Small boy's joy — genuine and unguarded. Energy bouncing up at the end, eager and genuine.
